outfit.name: 雪凇绒领象牙白短派克冬装
outfit.prose: A cropped ivory winter parka with a plush charcoal fur-trimmed hood worn open over a dark ribbed turtleneck sweater, paired with a burgundy plaid wool mini skirt cinched by a brown leather buckle belt, thick charcoal knit over-the-knee socks, and fur-lined brown snow boots.
